general.notes: Product features state power dissipation < 1W (no exact W value). Case operating temperature: Commercial 0°C to +70°C; Extensional 0°C to +85°C (ordering and recommended operating). Link length stated as maximum 70 m on OM3 or 100 m on OM4; recommended operating lists transmission distance up to 100 m (OM4 or 70 m OM3); ordering table lists transmission distance 10 km. Optical receiver table row 'Average Receiver Power @25.78Gb/s' (RxMAX) is -10.3 to 3 dBm, not labeled as Rx sensitivity. Note 2: measured with PRBS 2^31-1 @25.78Gb/s, BER < 10^-5. Datasheet text spells emitter as 'VSCEL'.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether ordering-table distance (10 km) is intentional vs link-length text (70 m/100 m). Consider mapping RxMAX row vs explicit Rx sensitivity if added in future revisions. Add schema field for supply current (Icc max 300 mA) if electrical limits are needed.
